subject: RE: REQUEST FOR SUGGESTIONS: nine starter tasks (three each for Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen), suggestions only
body:
Suggestions only; nothing assigned, activated or supplied; Phase 0 untouched; no Don Juan notebook operations; Hon Dolo and Lisan kept separate.

The attached file gives three starter tasks each, every one with the current need, the bounded input package by path (or by pasted text for Qwen), the expected artifact, measurable completion and quality checks, dependencies and the actual tools required, supervision and time, reviewer and owner, priority, and how it avoids overlapping existing work, plus the dated-capability caveat (Kimi's and DeepSeek's local access was observed on October 10 in their own sessions and must be re-verified at the start of any assigned session; Qwen's surface is a chat window with no filesystem by its own account; none watches the mailbox).

In one line each:
  Kimi: K1 mailbox and identity consistency report (Kimi's own proposal, seconded); K2 coverage-call slot table with every anchor path resolved and hashed (feeds Nova's first Lisan dispatch); K3 hash ledger for the two writer folders against their posted hashes.
  DeepSeek: D1 C13 repair intake ledger and brief-delta reconciliation, text only (the first clip's source); D2 continuity and source-readiness matrix for the series plan and the cards, by episode; D3 lyric and cue mechanical check (string level, Lisan only, no timing).
  Qwen: Q1 generator-ready prompt lines for one coverage set (LAG-COV-00) as a draft Nova may use or discard; Q2 reader's continuity questions on Story 01 and the plan, each citing a line; Q3 structural review of a Comfy workflow JSON when and if Nova supplies one as text.

If one each: K2, D1, Q1. All text and measurement; none generates, spends, uploads or decides. DeepSeek's own October 10 proposal (the mouth count and the GAIIB/GAIB split) has moved since (grill lettering fixed in r3; mouth v002 at 38 tries with shape 16 a known defect) and the file says so.

Receipt for your 22c366e7 is 7fb04a1f (completed). CFA Nova reads this at her checkpoint; no separate copy is posted to her.
